page.layout: One page of text. Above the heading, a decorative fleuron band (not text). Page number at top left. Below it, a heading block of a dedication title, in capitals and small capitals, in the centre of the page.; One column of verse at the top, with a woodcut initial at its start. Below it, a dedication line in capitals, centred. At the lower right, the catchword "Io. Cal-".

main_text.l: D. OPT. MAX. S. ET MEMORIÆ CL. V. D.
doctae / Est si qua laus facundiae:
Si summis imisque piis placuisse, malorum /
Est vitae locuples testis vindéxq; probata, /
Ecquis te, STVRMI, vixit felicior? ecquis /
Non igitur, STVRMI, te lugeo: lugeo nullos /

page.notes: Decorative fleuron band above the heading, not transcribed. Small capitals in "D. Opt. Max. S." and "Cl. V. D." are set in capitals here. Spelling changed only for u/v and i/j as the rules require. The woodcut initial is decorative and hard to read; the first letter is given as "Si" with [?]. Lines are run together within each stanza, since the poem's line breaks are not kept. The long s is written as plain s. Faint show-through from the reverse side, including "D. OPT.", is omitted.
